source.title: Architecture and Implementation of a Real-Time Game Theory Optimal Desktop Poker Application

adopted.idea: separate perception, temporal state, strategy and delivery workloads
asynchronous latency budgets and local blueprint fallback
four-color card input and environment-specific calibration profiles
OCR output must be checked against chip, pot and action invariants
blueprint strategy plus provenance-preserving safe refinement
public belief inputs require cards, action history, stacks and opponent-policy uncertainty

conditional_research_items: Deep CFR or SD-CFR only after a reproducible game abstraction, exploitability benchmark and compute budget exist.
ReBeL-style public-belief search only for game classes where its assumptions and evaluation are explicitly established.
Remote GPU refinement only after the local blueprint path, timeouts, provenance and deterministic fallback are verified.
Generic OCR engines may assist labels but cannot bypass controlled calibration and temporal validation.

rejected.idea: reward shaping suited connectors to force a LAG policy
rejected.reason: changes the utility and does not preserve a GTO claim; Negreanu evidence remains an explanatory/exploit feature, not a distorted equilibrium target
outside APC's local evidence scope and unnecessary for uncertainty-aware profiles learned from observed virtual-chip sessions

rejected.idea: fixed PokerStars coordinates and platform-specific architecture
rejected.reason: APC is platform-neutral and learns table regions through calibration profiles and detection
APC's current product boundary is visible-state coaching and controlled training, not anti-detection automation

rejected.idea: unqualified real-time GTO or unexploitable claims from neural approximation
rejected.reason: every strategy output must retain solver configuration, coverage, error and calibration evidence

source_quality_notes: The report mixes primary research papers, repositories, blogs, videos and secondary articles without a source-quality tier.
Several mathematical formulas are embedded as shapes and disappear from plain-text extraction.
Two-player zero-sum convergence results must not be generalized to arbitrary multiway poker without separate evidence.
The document is useful for engineering hypotheses but does not supersede APC's verified math graph, course evidence or promotion gates.
